title: Gratitude Scavenger Hunt/Arts & Crafts
blurb: Embrace the spirit of gratitude this fall with our delightful nature-based scavenger hunt! Enjoy exploring beautiful surroundings while discovering things to appreciate. Plus, unleash your creativity with some engaging arts and crafts. We will provide water, snacks, and art supplies. Appropriate for all ages. No pets are allowed, except for service/companion animals. Adverse weather or poor air quality may cancel. Check the calendar or text/call (415) 720-7759 two hours before the event to confirm the status. Registration is required. Questions: Contact Kate Whittingham
